purpose: PR29 follow-up to the separately preserved PR28 peak-memory campaign
limitations: Peak RSS is per-process-tree resident memory, not peak live BDD nodes.
The host rebooted between the PR28 campaign and this campaign, changing Linux 7.1.5 to 7.2.5. Both comparison binaries were rebuilt and rerun together here.
Pre-reboot exploratory follow-up screens were lost with /tmp and are excluded.
Matched, recommended, and confirmed pressure settings have three repetitions; other optional modes and historical defaults are one-run screens.
No physical-memory limit was imposed; each run has a 120-second timeout.
UNREALIZABLE results agree with pinned upstream annotations but lack independent counterstrategy certification.
